diagnostics.numerical_rank: rank uses max(matrix_shape)*machine_epsilon*s_max separately for raw and scaled matrices
diagnostics.production_covariance: not supplied; covariance-whitened information and acceptance threshold remain open
diagnostics.raw_svd: unscaled design matrix; reports physical mode-amplitude suppression and shape together
diagnostics.unit_column_scaled_svd: each design column normalized to unit Euclidean norm; compares shape collinearity only

limitations: spectral energies are fixed hand-set toy values, not fitted or measured
linear design rank does not validate the nonlinear GEVP/spectral estimator
unit-column scaling removes absolute signal size and cannot establish practical identifiability
no measurement covariance, noise, bootstrap, interval coverage, or force bound is used
the planned exporter time origin and endpoint factorization still require independent review

model.baseline: (m=0,n=0) coefficient fixed to one; five correction coefficients remain
